record_type_quote:
The present study is a direct replication of experiments 1a and 1b of

Greene et al. (2009) in a Canadian sample of undergraduates.

targets.authors: Greene, J.D., Cushman, F.A., Stewart, L E., Lowenberg, K., Nystrom, L.E., & Cohen, J.D.
targets.title: Pushing moral buttons: The interaction between personal force and intention in moral judgment.
targets.evidence_quote:
We replicate findings of experiments 1a and 1b of Greene et al (2009), to verify prior

research on consequential vs. deontological responses to hypothetical moral dilemmas.
targets.outcome_quote: These results partially replicate Greene et al. (2009).
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly give an overall partial-replication verdict. There is ambiguity: the tested personal-force effects agree and the null physical-contact results also agree; partial may refer to testing only a subset of the original experiments. Following the stated overall verdict, code mixed with low confidence.

reasoning: Identity verified from title page and authors; complete manuscript includes references. One published target; Awad, Bago and Milgram are contextual citations, not independently retested findings.
